integrity: Proof depends on transparent complete integer trial division with exact finite candidate enumeration; the independent arithmetic replay is a second check, not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The exact finite exclusion is restricted to the least vertex of directed prime three-cycles at most 349; existence or classification of cycles with larger least vertex is not determined.
No assertion that the exhibited integer is the least reciprocal-gcd-integral product of three primes, and no assertion of infinitude.
A previously unindexed tabulation of the same finite cutoff remains possible.
title: The least prime in a three-cycle of sixth-cyclotomic divisibility
